scenes.text: Event PayNow Bot: collect PayNow payments for your event, right from Telegram.
Event organizer: add the bot to your group and send /init to create an event.
Share the payment page with /web_payment, or issue a QR yourself with /start.
Tap Received when the money arrives, or Void to cancel a request.
Open /web_admin to check attendees in: scan their QR, or tap Check-In on their row.
Need to refund someone? /payback makes a QR to pay the money back.
Attendee: you get a link to the payment page, or a PayNow QR in the chat.
Scan the QR with your banking app and pay.
Keep the QR: it is your proof of payment and your ticket at the door.
Add the bot on Telegram: t.me/event_paynow_bot
